workflow:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CERN-OHL-W-2.0
# The consumption contract (hdl/README.md): the consumer's submodule pin moves
# only to a commit whose gates are green HERE first. Verilator is pinned and
# built from source — distro packages have failed the reference platform twice
# (5.020 cannot build datapath harnesses; 5.032 reads back zeros).
name: hdl
on: [push, pull_request]

env:
  VERILATOR_VERSION: v5.050

jobs:
  docs-gates:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Link, matrix, wavedrom and staleness gates
        run: |
          python3 -m pip install wavedrom
          python3 scripts/check-links.py
          python3 scripts/check-matrix.py
          python3 scripts/render-wavedrom.py --check
          make stale

  suites:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      # Full main history, not the default depth-1: the nvm_port figure gate
      # compares its matrix injections with historical implementations.
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Cache the pinned Verilator build
        id: cache-verilator
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/verilator
          key: verilator-${{ env.VERILATOR_VERSION }}-${{ runner.os }}
      - name: Build Verilator ${{ env.VERILATOR_VERSION }}
        if: steps.cache-verilator.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y git help2man perl \
            python3 make g++ libfl2 libfl-dev zlib1g zlib1g-dev autoconf flex bison
          git clone --depth 1 --branch $VERILATOR_VERSION \
            https://github.com/verilator/verilator ~/verilator-src
          cd ~/verilator-src && autoconf && ./configure --prefix "$HOME/verilator"
          make -j"$(nproc)" && make install
      - name: Lint (zero tolerance) + every suite
        run: |
          export PATH="$HOME/verilator/bin:$PATH"
          verilator --version
          ./scripts/lint_hdl.sh
          ./scripts/run_suites.sh
      - name: Traceability matrix no-drift + untested budget 0
        run: python3 scripts/gen_matrix.py --check

      # Out of run_suites.sh on purpose: too slow for the per-suite loop, and
      # it prints its own derived build count rather than quoting one here --
      # that number was stale in this file for two rounds. "Run it by hand
      # after a change" is the discipline that let the nvm_port figures go
      # stale in four consecutive reviews, so it gates here instead, where
      # Verilator is already built.
      - name: nvm_port README figures agree with the tree
        run: |
          export PATH="$HOME/verilator/bin:$PATH"
          # PR #13 was squash-merged. Its review lineage is therefore absent
          # from main, but remains available through GitHub's durable pull ref.
          git fetch --no-tags origin refs/pull/13/head
          make -C tb/nvm_port figures

  portability:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install yosys + sv2v
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y yosys
          curl -sL https://github.com/zachjs/sv2v/releases/latest/download/sv2v-Linux.zip \
            -o /tmp/sv2v.zip && sudo apt-get install -y unzip
          unzip -o /tmp/sv2v.zip -d /tmp/sv2v
          sudo install /tmp/sv2v/*/sv2v /usr/local/bin/
      - name: Elaborate every top off-vendor
        run: ./syn/yosys/run.sh
